C0757.title: Shanghai Ctrip Commerce Fined RMB 10 Million for Data Export Violations
C0757.summary: On June 13, 2026, the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration reported a batch of network data security enforcement cases handled under the guidance of the national cyberspace regulator. Shanghai Ctrip Commerce Co., Ltd. was fined RMB 10 million under the Personal Information Protection Law for failing to meet data export security assessment requirements and illegally exporting personal information, and was ordered to rectify the violations. The company actively cooperated and implemented remediation requirements.
